misprints.note: Under Ideel, the print clearly shows ι with an acute accent followed by ς.
Under Idka, the syllable ρι is missing in the print (μετα- at the line end, χείζεσθαι on the next line).
ἀπο is printed with a breathing and no accent.
The accent on υ looks like a grave, not the clear circumflex of the nearby τοῦ. The later 'τό ἀπὸ τοῦδε' has a circumflex.
The article is printed with an acute, not a grave.
No punctuation between rik and fattig (fat-tig is broken at the line end).

uncertain.note: The ε in 'πένητα γίγνεσθαι' is broken type and shows only as a dot. Read as ε.
No breathing is visible on αυτου, so it could be αὑτοῦ. Kept αὐτοῦ.
The mark after ἐκ could be a comma or a full stop. Read as a comma, matching 'ἐκ, ἀπὸ τῆσδε' below.
The mark after σπουδή is small and could be a full stop. Read as a comma, the usual form before an article.
The hyphen after 'συγ)' falls at the line end. Treated as a line-break hyphen and dropped.
The breathing on οἷος is too small to tell. Kept the rough breathing.
